title: achetaria floribunda

This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
